entries.title: Ask PG: Can you start a HN crowd-funding venture?
entries.author: tstegart
entries.current_title: Ask PG: Can you start a HN crowd-funding venture?
entries.excerpt: Just thinking how much fun it would be to have a Kickstarter-like fund but with real equity. Maybe the HN community could pick its own YC applicant each season that gets into YC if the HN community funds it. We could see how valuable the wisdom of the crowd is when it comes to real investing. :)

entries.title: Ask HN: Please be more thoughtful when downvoting
entries.author: guynamedloren
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Please be more thoughtful when downvoting
entries.excerpt: Lately I've noticed far too many constructive comments that have been downvoted (usually without any explanation). Please stop this. It's okay to have comments that are not in support with the original post or your own thoughts. We don't have to shoot them down. Downvoting is meant as a management tool to filter out comments that negatively impact the community, or ones that provide no substance or insight. Please do not downvote legitimate comments. Thank you.
entries.guide_zh: 作者呼吁踩评论前多想一步，不要无解释地打压有建设性的发言。

entries.author: zorlem

entries.title: Ask HN: How is your Start-Up Chile experience?
entries.author: boolean
entries.current_title: Ask HN: How is your Start-Up Chile experience?
entries.excerpt: I applied for the current round and will know by next month if I get accepted. What I read are mostly positive, however I'd love to hear your experiences. Are the required events very time consuming? Can you get by easily with the maximum salary you can take? Is it easy to find local talents with good English skills?
